simple.meaning: עֹצֶם (ʻôtsem) is a Hebrew word meaning “power ; hence, body.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: עֹצֶם (H6108) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 8:17, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֹצֶם (H6108) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in עֹצֶם (H6108) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: עֹצֶם (ʻôtsem) / H6108 is traced through Deuteronomy 8:17, Job 30:21, Psalms 139:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H6108. otsem עֹ֫צֶם noun [masculine] might, bones ; — 1 might , construct ׳י יָדִי Deut 8:17 , ׳י יָָֽדְךָ Job 30:21 ; suffix עָצְמָהֿ Nahum 3:9 (Ges § 93e ); + ׳בְּי רוּחז Isa 11:15 (Thes and others; for ר ׳בַּעְיָם ᵑ0 ). 2 bones (collective): suffix עָצְמִי Psa 139:15 = my frame .
